authentication.method: Read actual ARM instructions with nixpkgs binutils-unwrapped-all-targets objdump -D -b binary -m arm --adjust-vma=0x61c400; read descriptor words with od.

implementation.initialize_grid_tables: 0x6e3b38(1,100,0), 45 input rows of eight signed halfwords at 0x3e3a55, 101-byte records at 0x400000, aggregate success at 0x4011c1
implementation.initialize_registered_tables: 0x6e45d0, gated by 0x3e0009, six descriptor rows, 101-byte records at 0x403600, aggregate success at 0x4011c1
implementation.publish_channel_tables: 0x6e3eac, fifteen channels replicated to six banks beginning 0x401200, 0x4017eb, 0x401dd6, 0x402400, 0x4029eb, 0x402fd6
implementation.search: 0x6e0558, descending 64/32/16 grid attempts, decrement-limited strengths, output retained across unsuccessful rows
implementation.supplied_selection: 0x6e0b58, supplied samples, descending 64/32/16 grids, zero metadata after exhausted selection; directional argument is not read by actual instructions
implementation.fixed_request: All three exporters construct the same zeroed 0x50-byte request with dimensions 4896 by 3264, format zero, source limits 4895 and 3263, unity scales and zero padding. Scratch is represented by its varying gains and coefficients; fixed request fields are not an unfinished provider boundary.
implementation.publication_layout: 31 little-endian low-24-bit samples followed by low-16-bit horizontal gain, vertical gain and two coefficients. Channel setup is 0x780 bytes: fifteen u32 direction flags at zero and fifteen arrays of 31 u32 samples at 0x3c.
implementation.canonical_geometry_boundary: The separate 0x6e3170/0x6e384c image_build_radial_geometry engine remains owned by startup_radial_geometry. This module implements the distinct 0x6e037c/0x6dfabc engine and does not copy the canonical calibration_core curve engine.

limits: Source-only implementation and behavioral tests; no build, test, lint, format, native execution, SDK or camera operation performed.
Exports own the fixed startup request; this is not a general public replacement for arbitrary image-warp requests.
A stock coefficient-overflow infinite loop is represented by BackendError::Range.
